messages:
claire: quick async standup — what I did: rolled out alert tweaks to reduce pager noise (silenced noisy 5xx spikes from preflight). Blockers: seeing a recurrent small SLO blip on embeddings routes during bulk ingest. Today: will triage ingest pipeline and coordinate with infra for a canary.

ryan: thanks. which ingest job cluster? is it the batch-embedder or live stream?

claire: batch-embedder (ingest-batch-us-east). The blip shows p99 embed latency jumping ~1.8% for ~4m windows, coincident with parallel bulk loads.

meera: root cause hypothesis: autoscaler cooldown + queue fan-in. When many shards push at once HPA lags and some requests hit slower fallback workers. I can look at HPA events for ingest-batch-us-east.

devops-bot: Alert created: TEMP-EMB-BULK-LAG-5112223333 — Monitoring embed p99 spike during bulk ingest.

patrick: FYI I saw a similar pattern last week when a client retried uploads aggressively; we had to add a small jitter to retry backoff. Any chance the client changed behavior?

claire: Not from our telemetry; spike aligns with internal one-off bulk run triggered by data-team job #D-998. I'll ping them to stagger runs.

oncall: Oncall here — I'll lift HPA cooldown to 30s for ingest-batch-us-east and watch scale events, then revert after window. Also enabling a transient alert: "embed_scale_delay > 15s for 5m".

meera: Good call. Also suggest pre-scaling policy: when bulk load job detected, ramp targets by +30% for 10m. I'll open a small runbook snippet for that.

ryan: For the SLOs side: current error budget burn for embeddings is 0.9% monthly — small margin. We should avoid risky rollouts until we confirm stability.

claire: Agreed. No risky deploys on ingest clusters for next 6h.

devops-bot: Incident created: INC-5112223333-BULK-EMB-INGEST  Auto-assigned to @oncall. Quiet-window paging suppressed.

oncall: Pre-scaling applied. HPA cooldown = 30s now. Watching metrics: embed_p99, pod_pending_count, hpa_scale_events. Will report back in 8m.

patrick: Meanwhile I can add a transient rate-limiter on the job coordinator to smooth bursts. Low-risk config change; I will gate it to 10% of runners first.

meera: I'll pull HPA events — if we see repeated scale oscillation, we may need to increase target replica limits not just cooldown.

claire: Update 9m: embed_p99 improved on pre-scaled nodes; pending pods dropped to zero. HPA triggered 3 scale-ups in 2m then stabilized. Looks promising.

ryan: Nice. Keep the incident in monitoring until the job finishes and the post-load 30m window passes. Please add a short timeline to the incident with the runbook steps we used.

claire: Will add timeline and the follow-up ticket to implement pre-scale hooks for scheduled bulk loads. Ticket: OPS-1412.

patrick: I'll roll the rate-limiter to 10% now and watch for client timeouts; will hold full rollout for 2h.

meera: Note for handoff: on the next shift please check embed error budget and HPA event count; if scale events > 5 in 15m, escalate to infra.

oncall: Acknowledged. INC-5112223333 status: monitoring. Actions: HPA cooldown temp change applied, pre-scale in effect, transient alert created, rate-limiter canary started. Will update at close or on regression.

claire: :thumbsup: thanks team. If stable after 30m post-job, we'll close incident and add follow-ups. No other blockers from my side.
